description: The soil column is discretized into 25 layers, of which 20 are hydrologically and biogeochemically active. The deepest 5 layers are only included in the thermodynamical calculations. The hydrologically and biogeochemically active portion of the soil column is restricted to a thickness less than the depth-to-bedrock, which varies spatially. There are up to 12 layers for snow, depending on snow depth.
